entities.summary: Antoni Lukianowicz Andrzejowski was a Russian-Polish botanist, zoologist and paleontologist. He also used the pseudonym Stary Detiuk, meaning "old Detiuk". The standard author abbreviation Andrz. is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
